Message:
drm/amdgpu/gfx10: fix unbalanced MAP/UNMAP_QUEUES when async_gfx_ring is disabled

gfx_v10_0_kiq_enable_kgq() is called only when async_gfx_ring is
enabled, so should gfx_v10_0_kiq_disable_kgq().
